blocks.title: Use subscription-backed models through one local endpoint
blocks.description: Connect supported provider accounts with CLIProxyAPI, discover their routable models and add protocol-aware providers to Vetta without copying or forking the upstream project.

blocks.content: This is a third-party integration. Provider terms, regional rules and account policies still apply. You explicitly start each OAuth flow; Vetta does not import browser cookies or credentials from other CLIs.

items.title: Upgradeable without a fork
items.description: The marketplace pins CLIProxyAPI 7.2.147 and Gemini provider 1.0.5 by release URL and SHA-256. A plugin patch can move both locks after review, without a Desktop code change.

items.title: Six OAuth account routes
items.description: Browser OAuth: Gemini CLI, Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity. Device-code OAuth: Kimi and xAI. Gemini CLI comes from the separately pinned native provider plugin.

items.title: Protocol-aware Vetta models
items.description: Discovered routes are grouped into Google Generative AI, Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses and compatible Chat Completions providers. Unknown ownership falls back conservatively to Chat Completions.

items.title: Health at a glance
items.description: Each credential card carries its own request history, so a failing account is visible before it becomes a failing conversation. Its model list opens on demand rather than crowding the page.

items.title: Install and enable
items.description: The plugin downloads the two pinned assets for your OS and architecture; Vetta verifies SHA-256 again and starts the service on a dynamic loopback port.

items.title: Connect accounts
items.description: Open the CPA setup page from the sidebar and authorize a provider. Add another account at any time, or remove the old local credential before authorizing its replacement. Runtime upgrades retain connected accounts.

items.title: Sync models
items.description: Fetch the live /v1/models catalog and publish each protocol group into the plugin-owned Vetta model namespace.

items.title: Run it from the CPA setup page
items.description: The CPA setup page in the sidebar lays every credential out as a card: its recent success and failure counts, a per-window health strip, and switches to disable, clear quota state or remove it.

blocks.content:
### Supported configuration channels

CLIProxyAPI also supports Gemini, Gemini Interactions, Claude, Codex, xAI and Vertex API-key configuration, Vertex service-account import, and explicit OpenAI-compatible upstreams. The initial plugin release deliberately exposes the six OAuth paths first; it does not proxy the unrestricted management `/api-call` endpoint or the upstream plugin store. API-key forms require provider-specific secret-handling UX and will be added in a later plugin release without changing Desktop.

### Runtime boundary

Desktop only supplies the generic managed-service lifecycle and plugin-owned model registry. Every CLIProxyAPI endpoint, provider name, OAuth state transition and protocol mapping lives in this marketplace package.
